column3: NKJV includes “and troubles,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “there will be famines.” “Birth pains” is rendered “sorrows.”
Close to the Greek; “courts” is rendered “councils” and “governors” as “rulers.”
NKJV includes “or premeditate,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “do not be anxious beforehand.”
NKJV includes “spoken of by Daniel the prophet,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “your flight,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “that it may not happen in winter.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV has “it is near,” where the Greek may also be read “He is near.”
